styles.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup, a finished full-bleed portrait Chinese mobile game visual design. Make ONE clean, high resolution image approximately 390:844 aspect ratio, matching the exact overall proportions of reference Image 1. No outside phone shell, no gray surrounding frame, no annotations or comparison panels.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image 1 is the APPROVED 04 mockup and is the layout, spacing, food-card sizing, button hierarchy and screen composition master. Image 2 is the STYLE / MATERIAL reference for this new theme; its old layout and empty board are not to be copied. Restyle the approved mockup into the requested theme. Preserve recognizable foods and the same large legible ivory food-card faces.
LAYOUT INVARIANTS: one continuous illustrated background fills the entire screen including behind the very top system controls and bottom home indicator. No separate-colored top panel, abrupt horizontal seams, stretched strips, mirrored textures, missing chunks, or pasted rectangles. A centered black Dynamic Island at very top, and WeChat dark translucent ellipsis/circle capsule upper right are overlays on that same scene. The game title is just below the Dynamic Island, no collision with the capsule. Exact title “锅里捞啥”, with complete smooth edges. A small matching gear setting button is on the right, beneath the WeChat capsule. NO collection/book button.
Below title, exact text “第 3 关 · 千层盛宴”, then “距离下一次获取道具还有91个”, then a slim progress track and small themed treasure/gift ornament to the right. Keep this area compact exactly like approved Image 1.
The large game board fills almost the entire central width and about 44% of screen height. Copy the approved generous figure-eight formation: two vertically touching elliptical rings, around twelve exposed large food cards per ring with a subtle darker offset layer behind them, filling the board height and most of board width. Cards should be approximately 38–43 logical pixels wide on a conceptual 390-pixel screen, visibly LARGE, never miniature. Detailed appetizing illustrated / sculpted ingredients inside: shrimp, mushroom, corn, bok choy, tofu, lotus root, beef cubes, abalone, dumpling. Each ingredient occupies most of its card face. Maintain natural tile proportions. No text on food cards, no random scattered tiles and no huge unused board margins.
Under board is one sculpted tray with EXACTLY SEVEN evenly spaced deep square slots in ONE row; the first three contain shrimp, mushroom, corn tiles.
Next three equally sized tactile tool buttons, with embossed gold undo arrow + exact “撤回”; cartoon dark bomb + exact “炸”; sculpted two curved shuffle arrows + exact “翻锅”. Small coral counters at upper-right read “1”, “0”, “1”.
Below are TWO matching and equally wide, symmetrically centered restart and sound buttons with an even gap and shared centerline. They must look premium and native to the new theme, with dimensional rims, engraved/raised icons and warm light-colored text, NOT generic flat white pills or white background black text. Left: restart icon + exact “重新开始”. Right: speaker icon + exact “声音：开”. Slightly subordinate to the three tools, but substantial enough to tap.
A thin dark home indicator near the bottom, with continuous scenery behind it. Keep the same compact use of space as the approved design. Precise Chinese lettering as specified, no extra text, no watermark. Polished premium casual mobile game visual, warm upper-left light, crisp material detail, food cards remain instantly readable.
THEME 01 — 市井朱红. Transform clay/cartoon cream into a richly illustrated traditional Chinese hotpot tavern at night: dark carved walnut, warm red lantern glow, aged antique brass/gold, deep jade and forest green lacquer. Continuous tasteful tavern scenery around perimeter, top roof beams and lanterns naturally continue behind the Dynamic Island; hotpot, chili, vegetables and chopsticks near outer bottom corners, no intrusion on controls. Iconic title is a red lacquer carved sign with gilded raised “锅里捞啥” characters and restrained sculpted chopstick/chili ornament, not a carrot plaque. The board is quiet deep green felt/lacquer in a beautifully shaped bronze-and-walnut rim. Cream warm ivory food tiles with subtle caramel edge and shadow. Seven-slot tray is dark carved warm wood with brass trim. Three tool buttons are deep jade-green inset lacquer with sculpted antique-gold rims and large gold icons, carved traditional shapes fitting the same wide pill proportions as reference Image 1. The two lower equal controls have dark red lacquer faces, rich walnut borders, antique-gold rims and embossed ivory/gold labels. Festive, premium, warm, sophisticated folk-tavern atmosphere, not cartoon clay, not dingy or overly ornate. Preserve the approved layout and the enlarged food cards.

THEME 08 — 青瓷雅韵. Transform the approved clay design into elegant Chinese celadon-glazed porcelain and ivory, with luminous pale jade, sage green, fine aged-gold accents, soft natural daylight. A refined tea-room/hotpot interior softly suggested around the outside: delicate window lattice, bamboo leaves, a celadon chopstick jar at outer left, small copper hotpot around outer right, quiet white-jade/marble tabletop. Continuous naturally painted scenery fills top and bottom, no horizontal sectioning. Title is a scalloped ivory porcelain plaque edged in celadon with exact deep forest-green calligraphic “锅里捞啥”, a tiny vermilion seal accent optional (no readable extra letters); NOT a carrot title. Small ceramic gear button at right. Main board is a quiet warm-ivory jade surface with an elegant rounded celadon porcelain rim and thin antique-gold detail. Large warm ivory food tiles with glazed celadon edging; colorful foods pop against pale board. Seven-slot tray is a carefully crafted celadon-glazed ceramic dish with small bronze handles and exactly seven recessed jade slots. Three tool controls are glossy celadon porcelain and ivory plaques with subtle crackle glaze and gold trim; sculpted golden/green icons; dark forest-green tool labels. Two lower equal-width restart/sound controls are beautiful deep jade-glazed ceramic inset buttons with ivory ceramic raised rims and warm gold detail, ivory labels and embossed golden icons. This should be light, graceful, tactile ceramic, not plasticky green clay, not washed out, not generic white pills. Match approved layout and large readable card sizes.

THEME 09 — 宣纸朱印. Transform approved clay design into sophisticated Chinese ink-and-vermilion art combined with exquisitely carved warm wood UI. Everything flows smoothly top-to-bottom, no empty top color strip, no texture bands. Exact title “锅里捞啥” in powerful complete black brush calligraphy with the final character accented in deep vermilion, fluid but very readable, and a small red seal ornament with no extra readable text; NOT a carrot plaque. Title and gear are safely below top system controls. Stage label is a slim red lacquer plaque with restrained gold corner scroll detail and ivory lettering. Main board is warm parchment/ivory with a slender carved walnut-and-brass frame, restrained geometric Chinese corners, softly quiet behind the big cards. Large tactile ivory tiles with wood/brown side edges and colorful appetizing food illustrations, not tiny monochrome food icons. Tray is warm carved wood with seven cream recesses. Three tool buttons are substantial rounded carved wood tablets with ivory insets, gold highlights and rich amber/green/red sculpted icons. Two lower equal-width restart/sound buttons are refined deep vermilion lacquer inset wood tablets with carved warm walnut/gold dimensional borders, raised golden icons and ivory text. Both share the same depth, size and centerline. Premium nostalgic illustration, ink poetry and material craftsmanship; not cream clay, not a busy painting behind the food, not generic white pills. Keep the approved composition and enlarged food cards.

approved04: Reused the user's approved 04 cream-and-clay preview without changes.
deviceComparison:
Create ONE premium side-by-side mobile game device adaptation comparison image, high resolution, near-square portrait presentation canvas (about 2048×2304). Reference image is the user-approved 04 cream/clay game design. Preserve that exact art style, tactile materials, proportions of large food cards, same gameplay state, same text, same button design. This is a visual mockup only, not a screenshot or code.

Put TWO complete portrait game screens side by side on a quiet warm off-white neutral presentation background with small equal margins. Thin subtle dark phone outlines only, no thick distracting device render, no perspective, perfectly straight front view. Large clear screens so UI remains readable. The only text OUTSIDE the two screens is their model and native screen-resolution labels, centered above each:
LEFT “iPhone 17” and “1206 × 2622”
RIGHT “HUAWEI Mate 60” and “1216 × 2688”
Do NOT give both devices identical screen aspect ratios. Left visible rectangular screen has aspect ratio width/height exactly 1206/2622 (0.459954). Right is the STANDARD Huawei Mate 60, not Pro, width/height exactly 1216/2688 (0.452381). At equal display scale the right screen is slightly narrower relative to height, and slightly taller; the small difference should be faithfully represented. These labels specify target device pixel resolutions; this is a scaled comparison mockup.

DEVICE SYSTEM OVERLAYS: Left iPhone has its black centered rounded Dynamic Island close to the top and a thin home indicator at bottom; right standard Mate 60 has ONE SMALL centered circular camera punch hole, NOT an iPhone island and NOT the Mate 60 Pro's three holes. Each has an unobtrusive WeChat dark translucent ellipsis / circle capsule in the upper right within that device's safe area. Keep them physically plausible and clear of title and gear. No unnecessary OS status text. Each phone's full-bleed artwork extends continuously under these overlays all the way to all screen edges; NO separate cream top strip or status-bar-colored rectangle, no horizontal seam, no mirrored/stretched textures. The background is one smooth unified cream tabletop with corner herbs/vegetables and green gingham cloth, exactly like the approved design.

ADAPTATION: Move only the orange clay title sign just enough downward to clear that phone's camera/system UI, not the entire game composition. No excessive empty top band. A complete smooth orange vegetable-shaped plaque with cream raised exact title “锅里捞啥”; cream clay gear button at the upper right below the WeChat capsule. No collection/book button. On iPhone the title has slightly more top clearance than on Mate 60. Optimize header compactly; preserve the large board and bottom controls. The board absorbs the small difference in available vertical space rather than shrinking the food cards.

BOTH GAME SCREENS use the SAME approved 04 visual layout and IDENTICAL game state, so device adaptation is easy to compare:
Below title a shallow cream sculpted lozenge with green exact “第 3 关 · 千层盛宴”.
Next exact “距离下一次获取道具还有91个”, slim inset cream/gold progress track and small orange/gold clay treasure chest.
Large recessed cream board with double soft peach rim uses nearly the full screen width. Two touching elliptical rings form a generous vertical figure-eight formation, around 12 exposed BIG square ivory cards per ring and a discreet darker offset tile layer underneath. Board occupies roughly 43–45% of screen height, figure-eight fills most of board. Food cards large enough to occupy 9–11% of the screen width each, natural proportions, crisp appetizing ingredients occupying most of each tile: shrimp, mushroom, corn, bok choy, tofu, lotus root, beef cubes, abalone, dumplings. No tiny miniature board. Same card positions and ingredients in both screens.
Below board EXACTLY SEVEN deep evenly spaced cream tray slots in one peach/orange sculpted tray. First three slots contain shrimp, mushroom, corn.
Next three equal raised leafy-green clay tool buttons with gold undo arrow + exact “撤回”, cartoon dark bomb + exact “炸”, golden curved shuffle arrows + exact “翻锅”; coral badges “1”, “0”, “1”.
Bottom control row: TWO equal-width dimensional clay buttons with rich green inset faces, chunky peach-orange sculpted outer rims, raised golden icons, cream text EXACT “重新开始” and “声音：开”. Symmetrical, centered, consistent centerline, like the approved mockup. Not flat generic white pills with black text. Keep a natural bottom safety margin, while the continuous food-and-cloth scenery fills the full screen.

Soft warm upper-left studio lighting, polished delightful 3D clay casual game aesthetic, rich tactile depth, delicate fine surface texture, clean smooth complete edges. No added diagrams, arrows, measurements, legal fine print, invented slogans or watermark. The TWO screens are the same 04 design adapted to two phones, NOT two different artistic styles.
